summary: Stricter private clipboard handling and credential exclusion.

changes.title: Private clipboard cleanup
changes.detail: Private and locked cleanup hides clipboard suggestions without reading the current system clip.

changes.title: Bounded plain-text history
changes.detail: Automatic text history and previews accept only a single direct plain-text item, not provider URI, intent or HTML coercion. Explicit paste and image support remain unchanged.

changes.title: Credential protection
changes.detail: Credential-bearing links, bearer tokens and private-key headers are excluded from automatic history and smart extraction.
